title: Was Mohanlal Replaced By A Body Double In Jailer 2? Action Director Sets The Record Straight
text:

 Was Mohanlal replaced by a body double in the Jailer 2 climax? No, action director Chethan Ramshi D’Souza confirmed that it was Mohanlal himself in the car scene.
